input.quote: 14. TERMINATION. Subject to Section 4 hereof, TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no post-termination transition or data-return provision. Section 14 (Termination) only fixes the date services stop; Section 13 places the burden on Client to arrange a new name server within 30 days and a new hosting environment within 60 days, without any TrueLink obligation to assist with migration or to return Client Content, Credit Data or other Client data. Section 10 (Confidentiality) contains no return-or-destroy mechanic, and Section 2(f) (backups) addresses only TrueLink's own backup practices. Nothing in the document reaches even the fallback (90 days of assistance plus export within 30 days). Inserted the preferred language after Section 14 — six months' assistance at then-current rates, return in machine-readable format within 30 days, then deletion with written certification (with a carve-out for legally required retention). The insertion sits in a surviving section under Section 24.

proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance and Client data return/deletion obligations into Section 14 (Termination).
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added an exit provision to Section 14: on expiry or termination TrueLink provides up to six months of transition assistance at its then-current rates, returns our data in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and then deletes and certifies deletion. The Agreement currently requires us to arrange a new hosting environment within 60 days but gives us no right to our own data or migration help, which is unworkable for borrower and loan data. We can accept 90 days of assistance as a fallback.

ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, TrueLink shall (a) at Client's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at TrueLink's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days, return to Client all Client Content, Credit Data and other Client data in TrueLink's possession or control in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion to Client in writing, except to the extent retention is required by applicable law.
